[EN] Don't look at me like that. Not all high elves are born with silver spoons in their mouths. Some of us have to work our way to wealth.

My legacy shall be built on this humble foundation.
[ES] No me mires así. No todos los high elves nacen en cuna de oro. Algunos de nosotros tenemos que abrirnos camino hacia la riqueza.

Mi legado se construirá sobre esta humilde base.
